column3: “plagued” renders “struck”; “by what I did” renders “just as I did.”
“the Red Sea” renders “the Sea of Reeds.”
“them” renders the Hebrew singular “it” (Egypt); “a long time” renders “many days.”
“when I destroyed them” renders “and I destroyed them.”
“he had to bless you” renders the doubled verb “he surely blessed you.”
“the citizens of Jericho” renders “the lords of Jericho.”
“sincerity and truth” renders “integrity and faithfulness”; “put away” renders “remove.”
“disagreeable in your sight” renders “evil in your eyes”; “house” renders “household.”
“consume you” renders “make an end of you.”
“put away” renders “remove”; “hearts” renders the Hebrew singular “heart.”
“obey His voice” renders “listen to His voice.”
“with the people” renders “to the people”; “them” renders “it.”
“being one hundred and ten years old” renders “a son of one hundred and ten years.”
